source_snapshot.test_name: Updated FPGA and HMC firmware will activate on AC power cycle
source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Stage firmware through BMC Redfish, monitor the update, AC-cycle the SUT, then verify activated FPGA and HMC versions.
procedure_facts: Text alternates Vulcan, HGX and DGX while the only target is FirmwareInventory/HGX_0.
Uses hardcoded admin credentials, disabled TLS, fixed Task 1 and misspelled `TaskStats`.
Attended time 10 minutes and machine time 30 minutes.
criteria_facts: Flash without error and correct new version.
source_conflicts: Two named components (FPGA/HMC) are not mapped to the single HGX_0 target; DGX/HGX/Vulcan names are mixed.
missing_source_information: Component/target/image/version/order/apply-time map, signed bundle, returned task semantics, AC-cycle ownership and recovery.

original_test_intent.statement: Verify approved FPGA and HMC firmware images are staged to the correct platform components and become the required versions only after the prescribed AC power cycle, with complete recovery and health evidence.
must_preserve: Firmware mutation and real AC removal/restoration, not reboot-only.
Both FPGA and HMC version outcomes and 30-minute machine-time plan.
must_not_infer: That Task 1 belongs to this upload.
That upload/task completion proves post-AC activation.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 identifies target ambiguity, requires separate FPGA/HMC images/versions/order, signed artifacts, rollback, task monitoring, explicit AC cycle and OOB recovery.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not explicitly require discovering the BMC-advertised multipart upload URI and following the task-monitor URI returned by the POST; it also does not distinguish staging/task success from active post-cycle version.

related_records: Generic Redfish firmware flows cannot establish this ODM platform's FPGA/HMC-to-HGX_0 mapping.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The FPGA/HMC activation purpose is preserved, but the conflicting component/target terminology must be resolved by the platform owner.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: No upload is allowed until FPGA and HMC are separately mapped to valid Redfish targets/images/versions/order. Use the advertised upload URI and returned task monitor, then require an operator-controlled AC cycle and independent active-version readback.

conditions_present: Mutation, AC-cycle activation and inventory readback intent are explicit.
missing: Exact platform/component targets, signed images and versions, dependency/order/apply-time, advertised upload URI, task success criteria, AC-off dwell and rollback/recovery.
provider: Platform/vendor owner resolves component map and signed recipe.
BMC owner supplies Redfish behavior and secure access.
Lab/operator approves and performs AC cycle/recovery.
safe_read_only_work: Collect platform/BMC/HGX identity, UpdateService capabilities, advertised upload URI, FirmwareInventory, current FPGA/HMC versions, task-service schema and baseline health/logs.
prohibited_until_resolved: Upload, target selection, task cancellation, reboot/power cycle, insecure credentials/TLS, updating one component speculatively or PASS.
closure_evidence: Signed component-target-image-version/order table, verified recovery/rollback, advertised endpoints and explicit flash/AC approval.

revision_candidate.test_name: Verify FPGA and HMC Firmware Activation After AC Power Cycle
revision_candidate.purpose: Stage the approved FPGA and HMC firmware to their separately verified targets, monitor each update transaction, perform the prescribed AC power cycle, and prove both components activate the exact approved versions with a healthy recovered platform.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact authorized Vulcan/HGX-based server, BMC/Redfish firmware and platform bundle recipe. The owner must reconcile the source's DGX/HGX/Vulcan terminology and map FPGA and HMC to actual SoftwareInventory/update targets.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Only the two approved FPGA and HMC components and their dependency-ordered image(s). One approved update sequence and one real AC-off/on cycle with specified off dwell; a warm reboot cannot substitute.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Signed component-to-target/current/target-version/image/checksum table; compatibility/dependency/order and apply-time rules; BMC-advertised update URI/capabilities; secure credentials/TLS; returned task-monitor semantics and success messages; active-workload drain; AC-off dwell/PDU owner; redundant image/rollback/vendor recovery; 30-minute window and explicit approvals.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Read and preserve UpdateService capabilities, full FirmwareInventory and FPGA/HMC active versions. Verify bundle signatures/hashes and target table. POST the exact approved multipart image/parameters to the upload URI advertised by this BMC, capture the response and follow its returned Location/task-monitor URI with Retry-After where provided; evaluate TaskState, TaskStatus and messages for each component/transaction. After staging success and owner approval, a qualified operator performs the specified AC-off dwell/on sequence. Reconnect independently and read both active component versions plus complete platform health.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Terminology/targets resolved; signed compatible images and order; secure management path; workloads drained; stable redundant power except controlled AC removal; console/PDU/OOB and vendor recovery tested; approval recorded.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Platform/BMC/HGX identity; reconciliation decision; pre/post full FirmwareInventory with separate FPGA/HMC IDs/versions/status; bundle manifest/signatures/hashes; discovered UpdateService upload URI/capabilities; exact targets/parameters; response status/headers; returned task-monitor URIs and complete TaskState/TaskStatus/messages timeline; operator/PDU AC-off dwell/on timestamps; BMC/host/GPU reconnect; SEL/dmesg/AER/GPU/management health; active-version comparison and recovery readiness.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Vendor-approved bundle/target/order/apply-time/AC-cycle recipe for the exact platform. Pass requires each intended update task to succeed without disqualifying messages, a genuine approved AC cycle, both active versions to equal the signed target table, and full BMC/host/GPU recovery with no disqualifying log delta.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not use literal admin credentials, disable TLS, assume HGX_0 covers FPGA/HMC, hardcode Task 1, inspect only `TaskStats`, update an unmatched component, interrupt staging, substitute reboot for AC cycle, chain the second update after a failure, auto-retry or declare activation from task success alone.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Vendor/platform owner approves targets/images/order/recovery; BMC owner approves endpoint/task semantics; lab owner authorizes state change; qualified operator controls AC power and remains available for recovery.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The agent may collect inventory, upload and monitor only after authorization; target mapping and AC operation are human-controlled, and final version/health judgment remains engineering responsibility.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Abort before upload on any mismatch. On task failure preserve all responses and do not update the next component. On failed activation/reconnect invoke the approved redundant-image/BMC/console/vendor recovery with PDU owner; do not repeat AC cycles or reflash without a new decision.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved DGX/HGX/Vulcan or FPGA/HMC target map; unsigned/incompatible image; unknown order/apply-time; no advertised/approved upload or returned task monitor; missing rollback/OOB/PDU approval; task warning/failure; power-control uncertainty; failed BMC/host/GPU recovery; version mismatch; incomplete evidence.

identified_defects: FPGA/HMC and HGX_0 target mapping conflict.
Hardcoded task URI and wrong task property.
Staging/task completion is conflated with active post-cycle version.
Unsafe credentials/TLS and no component-order recovery boundary.
reason_for_change: Keep the destructive activation intent while preventing upload to an assumed composite target or monitoring an unrelated task.

new_technical_evidence.title: DMTF Redfish Specification DSP0266 - Asynchronous operations and Update service
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Standard Redfish multipart update/task behavior; OEM target mapping remains platform-specific
new_technical_evidence.supports: Multipart upload URI is advertised by UpdateService; successful asynchronous POST returns 202 with a Location task-monitor URI; task completion uses TaskState, TaskStatus and messages.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The source endpoint/targets may be OEM behavior and must be confirmed on the exact BMC.

removed_ambiguities: Uses returned task monitor instead of Task 1.
Separates staged transaction success from activated-version acceptance.
Defines real AC cycle versus reboot.
resolved_blockers: Image/tool/approval absence is furnishable and does not make firmware updating inherently non-automatable.
remaining_blockers: Component mapping, signed recipe/order, recovery and AC-cycle approval remain unresolved.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 converts the generic HGX_0 flow into two owner-mapped component outcomes, follows the BMC-advertised upload and returned task monitor, and refuses to call staging successful activation until both versions are read after a real AC cycle.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator refused HGX_0 inference, required advertised upload and returned monitor URIs, separated staged tasks from both active post-AC versions, and preserved human-controlled real AC/recovery boundaries.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 263 says FPGA/HMC activation but uploads one bundle to HGX_0, polls Task 1 and AC-cycles.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 flags targets/recovery; V3 additionally binds the advertised upload URI, returned task monitor and post-AC active versions.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Only capability/inventory discovery is allowed before component mapping and destructive approvals close.
